title: Psychology of Habits: Why Your Environment Shapes Your Habits and Choices
description: Learn why changing your surroundings can make habit formation easier and reduce the daily struggle of relying on willpower. This guide explores environmental psychology, behavior change, and the hidden cues that influence your routines. Discover how your spaces, digital habits, and everyday objects shape decisions, plus the cue-routine-reward cycle that explains why behaviors repeat. See the full framework here.
alt_text: An infographic showing how a person's surroundings influence daily behavior, with visuals of a workspace, phone, home environment, and routine cues connected around the main topic of environmental habit design.
hidden_hook: The blog reveals how the cue, routine, and reward cycle explains why environmental signals can make habits repeat automatically.
